remarks: Light, bright, sunny, ranch-style living in this high floor unit. Freshly painted and updated, conveniently close to the elevator. Large 2BRs, 2 baths, multiple closets for ample storage. Open floor plan with kitchen island, stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and convenient in-unit washer and dryer. Main bedroom has a spacious walk-in closet, en-suite bath, and balcony overlooking the green areas of the complex. Enjoy the amenities of Mill River House with an inviting club room, well outfitted fitness room on the first floor. Enjoy the the private garden area with gazebo, picnic tables, and BBQ grills for residents' outdoor use. Pet friendly elevator building offers a gated, private garage with 2 parking spots per unit and ample parking for guests. Outstanding location just minutes to the mall, library, school, public transportation, dining, shopping, hospital, golf course, train station, and easy access to I-95. Mill River Park offers many year round attractions with festivals, outdoor movies, concerts, ice skating rink, walking trails, carousel, food trucks, and more. New Mill River Park offers walking and jogging trails leading to Scalzi Park with tennis, bocce and plenty of public amenities. A rare opportunity to own a move-in ready condo, in a very convenient Stamford, CT location, value priced for a quick sale.
